metadataDescription: Closed administration environment for LiquidHR customers.

login.title: Control room
login.subtitle: Manage customer environments, access, and usage from one closed location.
login.notice: There is no public registration. Only manually admitted operators can use this application.

setup.title: One configuration step remains
setup.body: The control app is running, but Supabase settings are missing. Create the local environment file and restart port 3001.
setup.source: Copy the two public values from apps/hr-suite/.env.local
setup.security: The control app deliberately does not use a service-role key for normal administration.

noAccess.title: Not a platform operator
noAccess.body: Your Supabase login is valid, but this account is not registered as an active platform operator.
noAccess.action: Sign out and use another account

installation.title: Apply the control-plane migration
installation.body: The application cannot find the secured control-plane function. Apply the new Supabase migration first, then add the first platform operator.

dashboard.title: Good afternoon, {name}
dashboard.subtitle: From customer status to scale: the current state of your LiquidHR platform.
dashboard.portfolioHint: View status, usage, and management options per customer. This does not log you in as that customer.
dashboard.recentChangesHint: Status changes, usage captures, and other management actions appear here.
dashboard.searchPlaceholder: Search by customer name or technical name

tenant.hrGroupsHint: Create the primary HR environments. Each group has its own visibility and setup boundary.
tenant.noHrGroups: No HR groups have been configured for this customer yet.
tenant.hrGroupCreated: The HR group has been created.
tenant.hrGroupInvalid: Check the code, name, and description.
tenant.hrGroupFailed: The HR group could not be created. Check your platform role and whether the code already exists.
tenant.viewModeHint: This page shows status, usage, and management options. It is not the customer environment or an impersonation mode.
tenant.lifecycleHint: A status change immediately affects access to LiquidHR.
tenant.reasonPlaceholder: For example: payment received or subscription terminated on request
tenant.errorInvalid: Check the selected status and provide a clear reason of at least five characters.
tenant.errorFailed: The status change was not applied. Check your role and the allowed transition.
tenant.auditHint: Status changes and usage captures for this customer appear here.
tenant.noAudit: No management activity has been recorded for this customer yet.
tenant.noTransition: No follow-up actions are available for this final status.
tenant.supportHint: Open a temporary, read-only view of this customer environment to provide support.
tenant.supportReadOnlyHint: You cannot change, upload, or delete data here.
tenant.supportReasonPlaceholder: For example: customer reports an error in the employee list
tenant.supportInvalid: Enter a reason of at least five characters and choose a valid duration.
tenant.supportFailed: Support mode could not be started. Check your platform role and whether another support session is already active.

onboarding.title: Prepare customer environment
onboarding.subtitle: Create the tenant and administrations. The environment remains in preparation until you deliberately activate it.
onboarding.name: Customer name
onboarding.model: How does the customer see the administrations?
onboarding.combinedHint: One employee list and shared setup; employments remain linked to their administration.
onboarding.separateHint: Users choose an administration and see only their permitted context.
onboarding.administrationsHint: These remain the legal or payroll units.
onboarding.invalid: Check all fields. The technical name uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
onboarding.failed: Creation failed. The technical name may already exist or you may not have write access.
onboarding.afterHint: Create or invite the first customer administrator through the existing LiquidHR invitation flow and activate the environment only afterwards.
